description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jhin''' throws a grenade at the target enemy that deals physical damage and can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, prioritizing the closest enemy that has not been hit.
description.text: Active: Jhin throws a grenade at the target enemy that deals physical damage and can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, prioritizing the closest enemy that has not been hit.

description2.raw: The grenade's damage is increased by 35% any time an enemy dies by any means after being hit by the grenade before it strikes its next target.
description2.text: The grenade's damage is increased by 35% any time an enemy dies by any means after being hit by the grenade before it strikes its next target.

notes.raw: * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will not prevent the canister from bouncing. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Spell shield will not prevent the canister from bouncing.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
